alloc-budget/ALLOC-FLOOD.reason: a seat flooding a scarce codex account is stepped down after its share passes 40%; its P0 request is still granted on codex

alloc-budget/ALLOC-NEAR-CAP.reason: codex at >= 95% steps down to openrouter; with openrouter dry work queues with the window refill ETA; P0 and cut are overridden

alloc-budget/ALLOC-CUT-RESERVE.reason: KST 03:00-06:30 leaves 20% reserve: work steps down (LLM) or queues (host); the cut gets the whole cap; no reserve by day

alloc-budget/ALLOC-TTL-RECLAIM.reason: a lease past TTL still holds capacity until reclaimExpired; never reclaimed early; capacity comes back after the reclaim

alloc-budget/ALLOC-UNATTRIBUTED.reason: an empty-context caller is granted as unattributed/unspecified and counted in the KPI and the summary line

alloc-budget/ALLOC-MODE-SHIFT.reason: advisor: tight LLM -> maintenance mode; free -> build mode; VM card only when every local host is saturated; repair for unreachable host and dead supervisor

alloc-budget/ALLOC-METERING.reason: identity chain seat->capsule->ta-card, inferred purposes, KST hour, usage from llm-proxy-call rows, wall-clock cpu-min, reconcile drift alert
